DALLAS–FORT WORTH AREA

Hospital discharges

Transportation from the hospital to home or an agreed care destination.

Planning your trip

Coordinate your request with the discharge team. Share the expected ready time, destination, mobility needs and contact person; discharge readiness and ride availability must be confirmed.

Can a family member arrange a discharge ride?

A family member or facility coordinator can request transportation and provide the pickup, destination and assistance details for review.

UNDERSTAND YOUR RIDE

Who this is for

For a patient being released from a hospital to home or another agreed destination, with the transport type reviewed by the care team.

How the journey is planned

Discharge transport depends on when the patient is actually ready to leave. Coordinate the pickup entrance, ready time, mobility needs and receiving contact with the discharge planner or nurse. If travel needs change, tell both teams before the ride; transportation does not replace discharge instructions or clinical care.

What we plan with you

  • Coordination with the discharge contact
  • Confirmed pickup and receiving destination
  • Mobility and handoff planning

Have these details ready

  • Hospital entrance and discharge-team contact
  • Expected ready time, confirmed when released
  • Receiving person or facility and access details

Questions about this service

Can you pick up before the discharge is complete?

The hospital must confirm the patient is ready for the agreed transport. Share the estimated time early, then update the transportation team when discharge timing is confirmed.

What if the patient cannot sit upright?

Ask the discharge team which transport type is appropriate. Stretcher transport and clinical monitoring are not among Compassion Care’s confirmed services; do not assume a standard ride will meet those needs.

Our team confirms pickup timing, vehicle suitability, assistance and return arrangements before accepting a ride.

Sources for general planning guidance
  • Mobility Transportation Services: patient FAQs
  • Call The Care: Fort Worth transportation

Details to have ready

  • Discharge ready time and coordinating contact
  • Home or receiving facility destination
  • Mobility needs and handoff arrangements

How to arrange a ride

Choose hospital discharges and prepare the trip details. The transportation team must review your request, vehicle suitability and availability before confirming pickup. A calendar appointment or prepared request alone does not confirm transportation.
